name: kliqo-ai
description: See how AI assistants and AI search answer your buyers' questions, whether they name your brand, and what to fix. Free AI crawler and page checks; your Kliqo workspace after sign-in.

interface.longDescription:
Kliqo AI shows how AI assistants and AI search answer the questions your buyers ask, whether they name your brand, and what to change so they do.

Without an account you can check whether AI crawlers can read a website, audit one page the way AI search sees it, get an llms.txt file and structured data written from the live site, write robots.txt rules for AI crawlers, and check whether a visitor's IP address really belongs to an AI crawler.

With a Kliqo account, sign in from the chat to read your own workspace: a briefing on what changed and what needs attention, your visibility and rank per AI model, the answers themselves, the questions where other brands are named instead of yours, the sites AI cites, your recommended actions and their measured impact, and real AI crawler visits to your site. You can also move an action, add prompts or track a competitor, each only after you confirm.

Kliqo AI reads only the one workspace you choose when you sign in, with your role's permissions. It can't change settings, start scans, see billing or invite anyone.
capabilities: Check AI crawler access to a website
Audit a page for AI search
Write llms.txt and structured data for a site
Write robots.txt rules for AI crawlers
Verify an AI crawler's IP address
Weekly briefing on your AI visibility
Visibility and rank per AI model
Questions where other brands are named instead of yours
Recommended actions and their measured impact
Real AI crawler visits to your site
Move actions, add prompts, track competitors after you confirm
defaultPrompt: Can AI crawlers read my website? Check it for me.
Give me my Kliqo briefing for this week.
Which questions does AI answer without naming my brand?

positive.description: Check AI crawler access to a website, no sign-in
positive.prompt: Can AI crawlers like GPTBot and ClaudeBot read stripe.com?
positive.expected_behavior: Without asking to sign in, reports each AI crawler's access to stripe.com (allowed, partly allowed or blocked) with the robots.txt rule that applies, notes robots.txt and sitemap health, and says plainly when nothing needs fixing.

positive.description: Audit one page for AI search, no sign-in
positive.prompt: Is https://stripe.com/pricing ready for AI search? Audit the page.
positive.expected_behavior: Without asking to sign in, lists problems with their fix first, then optional improvements and the checks that passed (crawler access, indexing, text without JavaScript, title, structured data).

positive.description: Weekly briefing from the reviewer's workspace, sign-in from the chat
positive.prompt: Give me my Kliqo briefing for this week.
positive.expected_behavior: The first time, ChatGPT asks to connect Kliqo AI. After signing in with the reviewer account and allowing access to the Kliqo AI (review) workspace, the same request continues and returns the brand's visibility, its rank among tracked brands, the open actions and suggested next steps.

positive.description: Questions where other brands are named instead
positive.prompt: Which questions does AI answer without naming Kliqo, and which brands does it name instead?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists tracked questions where AI answers leave Kliqo AI out, each with the brands named instead and how often, from the reviewer's workspace.

positive.description: Move an action to in progress
positive.prompt: Show my top recommended Kliqo action and mark it as in progress.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the top recommended action, moves it to in progress (a change, so ChatGPT may ask to confirm first) and confirms its new status; only the reviewer's own workspace changes.

negative.description: Unrelated request: Kliqo AI is not used
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.

negative.description: Billing isn't available through Kliqo AI: nothing is charged or changed, and ChatGPT says so
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Kliqo plan and charge my card.

negative.description: Deleting data isn't available through Kliqo AI: nothing is deleted (it may look the project up first), and ChatGPT says so
negative.prompt: Delete my Kliqo project and all of its data.

review.commerce_description: Kliqo AI doesn't sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: AI crawler and page checks without an account, and read access to your Kliqo workspace after sign-in, with confirmed changes to actions, prompts and competitors.
